findings.title: Broken Navigation Link to Missing Route (/broken-route)
findings.description: The navigation header or page anchor points to /broken-route which does not exist in the routing manifest, producing a 404 user drop-off.
findings.observedEvidence: Observed HTTP 404 Not Found response when browser navigated to http://localhost:4173/broken-route.
findings.aiHypothesis: The developer likely renamed or deleted the broken route or made a typo in the href attribute (e.g., href="/broken-route" instead of a valid route like "/about").
findings.suggestedFix: Update the anchor href in navigation or create the missing page file at src/app/broken-route/page.tsx.
findings.patchPreview:
--- a/src/components/Navigation.tsx
+++ b/src/components/Navigation.tsx
@@ -12,3 +12,3 @@
-<Link href="/broken-route" className="nav-link">Broken Link</Link>
+<Link href="/about" className="nav-link">About Us</Link>
findings.sideEffects: None; routes correctly to existing About page.
findings.verificationStep: Re-run PROOFix Navigation Flow test to verify 200 OK response.

findings.title: Internal Server Error (500) on API Route /api/data
findings.description: The endpoint /api/data crashed during request execution due to an unhandled database connection failure.
findings.observedEvidence: Server returned HTTP 500 with network failure reason "ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432".
findings.aiHypothesis: The database connection pool fails to connect because no PostgreSQL instance is running on localhost:5432, or the DATABASE_URL environment variable is unset/invalid.
findings.suggestedFix: Add connection error handling with fallback or mock data in development mode when DATABASE_URL is unavailable.
findings.sideEffects: Returns empty fallback payload when database is unreachable instead of crashing with HTTP 500.
findings.verificationStep: Re-run PROOFix API Health Check to ensure graceful recovery.

findings.title: Responsive Layout Horizontal Overflow Detected
findings.description: The application page width exceeds the viewport width on mobile screen dimensions (375px), causing unintentional horizontal scrolling.
findings.observedEvidence: Observed document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth at mobile viewport.
findings.aiHypothesis: Probable causes: (1) Elements with fixed pixel widths (e.g., width: 600px instead of max-w-full), (2) Negative margins or unconstrained pre/code tags without overflow-x-auto, or (3) Images missing responsive max-width rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed pixel widths with responsive Tailwind classes (w-full, max-w-full, overflow-x-hidden, or overflow-x-auto on tables/code blocks).
findings.sideEffects: Eliminates unexpected horizontal scroll on mobile devices.

findings.title: Critical CWE-89 SQL Injection in /api/users/search
findings.description: Raw string concatenation in SQL query allows arbitrary query execution and unauthorized data extraction.
findings.observedEvidence: Static AST inspection found template literal with req.nextUrl.searchParams in db.query call.
findings.aiHypothesis: Direct query interpolation permits authentication bypass and data extraction.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace template literal with parameterized query statement and pass parameters as array.

findings.title: Security Preflight Gate Deployment Blocked
findings.description: Repository blocked from runtime sandbox deployment due to critical policy failure.
findings.observedEvidence: Build status set to failed and runtime container launch blocked.
findings.aiHypothesis: Security policy requires 0 critical findings before container execution.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply parameterized patch to re-enable automated deployment pipeline.

findings.aiHypothesis: Route handler is missing from the src/app/api/checkout/ directory.

findings.title: Checkout Form Unhandled Exception
findings.description: Clicking #place-order-btn triggered an unhandled network error leaving UI frozen in loading state.
findings.observedEvidence: Button remained in disabled state after 404 failure without displaying error alert.
findings.aiHypothesis: Form lacks try/catch error handling around checkout fetch call.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap fetch call in try/catch and display user-friendly error state.

findings.title: React Hydration Mismatch Error #418
findings.description: Server markup and client DOM diverged at #live-server-clock due to unshielded timestamp evaluation.
findings.observedEvidence: Intercepted React console error #418: Text content mismatch at LiveServerClock.
findings.aiHypothesis: Direct Date() invocation during SSR causes client/server millisecond offset.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap dynamic timestamp output in a mounted boolean state check with useEffect.

findings.title: Intercepted Unhandled Console Exception
findings.description: Browser console threw fatal hydration error during initial page reconciliation.
findings.observedEvidence: 1 uncaught error logged to browser console before user interaction.
findings.aiHypothesis: Hydration failure causes React to bail out into full client rerender.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve server/client HTML divergence to achieve zero-warning console output.
